title: Yukon Glory Universal Portable Grill Table Stand

comparisons.notes: Exact match: MFG part number YG-1000, same title and features; sale price $164, marked in stock.

writeup: Yukon Glory's universal portable grill table stand (model YG-1000) is a folding stainless stand built for Blackstone 17 and 22 inch tabletop griddles, with legs that adjust from 22 to 30 inches. Woot has it new for $69.99, well under the $164 Camping World charges for the same model. Woot shows only a few left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
